message.content: Research is thin — the only substantive, verifiable data is Walmart's FY2024 (year ended 2024-01-31) 10-K, which I cross-checked against both Walmart's newsroom and SEC EDGAR, plus the trusted filing lookup. Q3 FY2025 results weren't out yet as of today (Nov 6). The fundamentals support a buy, so I'll size an order within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
The web is thin — only FY2024 10-K data and low-content roundups. So the research basis is FY2024 annual results.

Decision: Buy WMT. Rationale: FY2024 revenue $642.6B (+5% vs FY2023 net sales $611.3B), operating income $27.0B (+32%), net income $15.5B (+33%), diluted EPS $1.91 (+35%), OCF $35.7B. Strong fundamentals, defensive retailer. Price $69.96.

Order sizing: max $5,000 per order. 5000/69.96 = 71.47 shares. So 71 shares = $4,967.16. Limit price close to market: $70.00 (ask 69.98). 71 × 70.00 = $4,970 ≤ $5,000. Good.

Total today: $4,970 ≤ $10,000. Cash $50,000, no money moved out.

Place order.
